description: Historic HPMS Data (Sample) - 1993 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by Federal Highway Administration. Historic Highway Performance Monitoring System sample data for the year 1993. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 127 columns, among them TURNING RIGHT, DIRECTIONAL FACTOR, SINGLE UNIT VEH AVERAGE, SPEED LIMIT, NUM CLASSES CURVES B, PEAK PARKING. The portal shows 2022-07-08 as the last data update. Attribution given: Federal Highway Administration. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
